values.note: Ontonagon County Park 2026 fee schedule: daily camping $27 non-resident, $25 for a county resident (vehicle registered in Ontonagon County in the camper's name); lake-front 'prime' site $1 more a day. Tent sites (designated areas without electricity) $15 per tent. Monthly $783 / $725 resident; season $3,825 / $3,519. Camping fees include the park use permit and boat launching. Septic pumping $15 each time, as scheduled.

fees.source: https://ontonagoncounty.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/2026-Park-Fees.pdf ('DAILY - COUNTY RESIDENT** $ 25.00', 'DAILY - NON-RESIDENT 27.00', 'PRIME SITE (LAKE FRONT) ADDITIONAL $1.00 DAILY'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://ontonagoncounty.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/2026-Park-Fees.pdf ('PARK OPENS MAY 1, 2026 - PARK CLOSES OCTOBER 1, 2026'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Nightly camping is first come, first served: 'Contact the park personnel for availability. No advance reservations will be accepted', and sites must be paid in advance. Only season-long sites are reserved (county residents in January, then anyone through the last Friday in February, with the County Treasurer), at most 20 a year. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out 11 a.m.

note: Ontonagon County-operated park on the west shore of Lake Gogebic, south of Merriweather on M-64 (Bergland area; RV Life mislabels as city). Swimming beach (no lifeguard), boat ramp and docks; lake-front 'prime' sites. Up to 20 of its sites are rented for the whole season. Distinct from nearby Bergland Township Park and Lake Gogebic State Park. --Claude
summary: County park page and its 2026 fee schedule + park rules: $27 non-resident / $25 county resident, lake-front +$1; open May 1-Oct 1, 2026; no advance reservations for nightly camping (FCFS; only season-long sites are reserved, max 20); dump station, no sewer hookups (scheduled septic pumping). Changed booking reservable true/phone -> false/FCFS always, added fees and season dates. Note cleaned of the stale ~$20 price, season, booking and amenity text. Electric amperage, site count (43, chamber listing) and showers are not stated by the county.
